user.title: Home Assistant Glucose NG
user.description: Enter your shared secret and configure the integration.

data_description.shared_secret: The secret configured in your CGM uploader (Juggluco, xDrip, etc.). Minimum 16 characters recommended.
data_description.name: Name used to identify the sensor, e.g. 'Alice' or 'Glucosa'.
data_description.url_prefix: URL path prefix for the Nightscout endpoints, e.g. 'hagng'. Must not be empty.
data_description.threshold_low: Glucose value below which a hypoglycemia alert fires.
data_description.threshold_high: Glucose value above which a hyperglycemia alert fires.
data_description.rate_drop: Absolute rate of change (mg/dL/min) that triggers a rapid-drop alert.

error.range_invalid: Low threshold must be less than High threshold.
error.prefix_required: URL prefix must not be empty.
error.invalid: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant logs.
